tools.name: visualization_guide
tools.description: Returns comprehensive guidance for using a specific visualization type. This is a READ-ONLY guidance tool that provides detailed instructions, rules, examples, and best practices for creating visualizations in chat messages. Use this tool when you need to generate a chart, diagram, animation, or interactive element but are unsure of the exact syntax, parameters, or best practices. The tool returns complete documentation including: 1) Delimiter syntax and structure, 2) All available parameters with descriptions, 3) Multiple working examples you can extrapolate from, 4) Rules to follow for best results, 5) Common pitfalls to avoid, 6) When to use vs when not to use this visualization type. This tool covers 14 visualization types: APEXCHARTS (modern interactive charts), PLOTLY (data analysis charts), CHARTJS (simple charts), MERMAID (flowcharts/diagrams), THREEJS (3D graphics), GSAP (UI animations), LOTTIE (loading animations), EXECUTE_HTML (interactive widgets), CAD (engineering drawings), SCHEMATIC (electrical circuits), BLUEPRINT (architectural plans), MOLECULE (chemical structures), LATEX (math equations), SVG (vector graphics). Call this tool BEFORE attempting to create a visualization to ensure you use the correct syntax and follow best practices.
